title: First captain gives economic destabilization as reason for secrecy

tellings.quote: why is this whole thing being kept secret and he talked about economic destabilization

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells the account of Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, hired him in the early 1990s to talk with aliens. According to the telling, when Sherman asked a captain he worked under at the agency's complex in Maryland why it was all kept secret, the captain said it was to avoid economic destabilization, meaning the news could shake the economy.
